name: Shiinoha Kotone
source:
Favorite food: Sukiyaki

A descendant of the miko household that has served the royal family for nearly 2000 years. Aiming for the nation’s finest miko, she has received strict training ever since childhood. Cheerful and just a tiny bit of a klutz she has a hobby of helping out Sojin.
